subject: general
question: Which of the following criteria is NOT essential to qualify as a 'superb' stamp?

options.text: It must be an unused stamp

solution:
The correct answer is **'****It must be an unused stamp.'**

***__Key Points__**

 
• Let's have a look at these sentences in the fourth paragraph of the passage: 
 
 
• ***' *A stamp which can be called 'superb' is one of the finest qualities. That means it has perfect centring, brilliant colour and perfect gum. A used stamp can also be called superb, if it is perfectly centred, fresh looking, is lightly cancelled and undamaged.*'***
 
• *​*It can be concluded from the above line that *the criteria which is NOT essential to qualify as a 'superb' stamp is it must be an unused stamp. (मानदंड जो **'Superb'** टिकट के रूप में अर्हता प्राप्त करने के लिए आवश्यक नहीं है, वह हैं एक अप्रयुक्त टिकट होना चाहिए।)
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
